- scripts/label_helpers.sh:172 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The warning message in the jq aggregation failure path says “GET labels failed” even though the GET request already succeeded.

- scripts/label_helpers.sh:151 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `phase_labels` array used for atomic swaps is missing active phase labels, including `ai:implement-fix-up`, `ai:destructive-blocked`, and `ai:comprehensive-test-pending`.
  WHY: Because the helper only removes labels listed in `phase_labels`, omitted phase labels can remain on an issue alongside the new label, creating contradictory state.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2333-2397,3041-3100 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` implementations only POST-add the target label instead of performing the atomic swap.
  WHY: This leaves stale phase labels in place when the helper script cannot be sourced, so the workflow no longer enforces the swap contract in fallback mode.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3041-3100 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The recovery path for the review-blocked failure step does not source the full helper suite consistently with the success path.
  WHY: If the install branch is taken, missing helper symbols can force unnecessary fallback behavior or break parity with the success-path sourcing logic.
- tests/test_phase_label_transition_and_fallback_contract.py:3 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `re` is imported but never used.
  WHY: This is a minor cleanliness issue and does not affect runtime behavior.
- tests/test_phase_label_transition_and_fallback_contract.py:42-58 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test uses exact string matching for shell command patterns.
  WHY: Small workflow formatting changes could make the test fail even if behavior is unchanged, which increases maintenance burden.

  WHY: When the support script is missing, stale AI phase labels remain on the issue because the fallback does not remove old labels.
